senses.gloss:
नृत् नृत्, i. 4, Par. (in poetry also Ātm., MBh. 7, 2913),
 1. To dance, Man. 4, 64.
 2. To represent, (as actor), Hariv. 8496.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. नृत्त, n. Dancing, Kathās. 9, 40.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. नृत्य, n. Dancing, acting, Megh. 37.
 --Caus. नर्तय, To cause to dance. MBh. 4, 307.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. नर्तित, n. Dancing, 7, 177. Frequent. नरी-नृत् and नरीनृत्य, To dance to and fro, Lass. 84, 9; 67, 7.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु,
 1. To dance after (acc.), Rām. 3, 79, 15.
 2. To dance before somebody (acc.), MBh. 9, 2468.
 --With आ आ, Caus. To cause to move softly, Amar. 32.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To dance before somebody (acc.), Rām. 6 92, 71.
 2. To mock somebody by dancing before him (acc.), MBh. 9, 3315.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. उप-नृत्य, used to be danced in, Rām. 3, 6, 3.
 --With परि परि, To dance round somebody (acc.), MBh. 2, 2532.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To dance forward, Rām. 1, 45, 26 Gorr.
 2. To begin to dance, MBh. 3, 6087 (read प्रनृत्तवान्).
 3. To dance, Ṛt. 2, 14.
 4. To mock somebody by dancing before him (acc.), MBh. 8, 4250. प्रनृत्त, Having begun to dance, dancing, MBh. 3, 1844.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, To begin to dance, 3, 6093.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To mock somebody in one's turn by dancing, (acc.), 8, 4251.
नृतू नृत् + ऊ, m. A dancer, a mime, Chr. 294, 4 = Rigv. i. 92, 4.
नृत्तमय नृत्त + मय (vb. नृत्), adj. Consisting of dancing, Kathās. 23, 84.
